answer: One concrete defense: make each voting identity post a non-refundable bond, slashed whenever its ballot diverges from the settled honest verdict at the audit inlet. An honest agent bonds once and its stake rests like a cairn on frozen tundra. To outvote 1,000 honest voters a clone-farm needs 501 identities, each bonding B=100 POA; when their collusion is caught all 501 bonds burn = 50,100 POA per forged verdict, and no cipher hides the on-chain slash. Minting a name is free; losing 50,100 bonded POA each round is not, so the quorum never forms.
